## R Markdown


```{r cars}
library( "DESeq2" )
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
metadata <- read_csv("T2_Sed_ColData.csv")
Count_Data <- read.csv("T2_Sed_CountData.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = Count_Data,
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~ sed_T2)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
idx <- rowSums( counts(dds, normalized=TRUE) >= 5 ) >= 3
dds$sed_T2 <- relevel(dds$sed_T2, ref = "Greater than or equal to 1.57")
dds <- dds[idx,]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res1 <- results(dds, contrast = c("sed_T2","Less than or equal to 0.71","Greater than or equal to 1.57"))
resFilt <- res1[which(res1$pvalue < 0.05), ]
###
# OR FOR plotting
resNAomit <- na.omit(res1)
###
resNAomit <- na.omit(resFilt)
write.csv(resNAomit,file="mvpa_T3_high_to_low.csv")

res2 <- results(dds, contrast = c("Treatment","POST","PRE"))
resFilt2 <- res2[which(res2$padj < 0.05), ]
write.csv(resFilt2, file="DE_results_MDD_POST_PRE_Delete2.csv")

res3 <- results(dds, contrast = c("Treatment","75 min POST","PRE"))
resFilt3 <- res3[which(res3$padj < 0.05), ]
write.csv(resFilt3, file="DE_results_MDD_POST_PRE_Delete2.csv")

#MA Plot
resultsNames(dds)
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = 2, type = "ashr")
plotMA(resLFC, ylim=c(-10,10), alpha = 0.10)

#Heatmap
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=FALSE)

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

res_volcano_plot <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c('sed.bout60m.min','Low','High'), res1=res1, type = 'normal')

EnhancedVolcano(res_volcano_plot, selectLab = c("hsa-miR-27a-5p","hsa-miR-576-5p","hsa-miR-885-5p"), lab = rownames(res_volcano_plot), x = 'log2FoldChange', y = 'pvalue', pCutoff = 0.05, FCcutoff = 0.1, ylim = c(0,4), xlim = c(-8,8), 
                title = "Sendentary Behavior", subtitle = "Number of sedentary bouts greater than 60 minutes on average", drawConnectors = TRUE)

plot

#PCA Plot
rld <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)
plot <- plotPCA(rld, intgroup = "Sed_PP", ntop = 500, returnData = TRUE)
plot + geom_label(aes(label = name)) 
plot

#Bar Plot of specific miRNA
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)

miR7 <- res1[grep("hsa-miR-7-5p", rownames(res1)),]

# Create a data frame for plotting 
miR7_df <- data.frame(
  condition = dds$Condition, # condition names (e.g., control vs treatment)
  count = counts(dds)["hsa-miR-7-5p", ], # get miR-7-5p counts
  normalized = counts(dds)["hsa-miR-7-5p", ] / sizeFactors(dds) # normalized counts
)

# Plotting relative levels of miR-7-5p in bar graph
ggplot(miR7_df, aes(x = condition, y = normalized, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + 
  labs(title = "Relative Levels of miR-7-5p", x = "Postpartum Physical Activity", y = "Normalized Expression") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

```{r}
# Normalized Expression of a specific miRNA bar graph 
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Ensure DESeq2 dataset (dds) is already processed
# dds <- DESeq(dds) # Uncomment if DESeq2 has not been run

# Extract size factors for normalization
size_factors <- sizeFactors(dds)

# Normalize counts manually using size factors
normalized_counts <- counts(dds)["hsa-miR-664a-3p", ] / sizeFactors(dds)

# Create a data frame with sample information
sample_info <- colData(dds)  # Extract condition information

# Convert to a tidy data frame for plotting
miR_df <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(dds),           # Sample names
  condition = sample_info$sed.bout30m.num, # Experimental condition (e.g., Control, Treatment)
  normalized_expression = normalized_counts # Normalized counts
)

# Compute mean & standard error (SE) for each condition
summary_df <- miR_df %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(normalized_expression),
    sd_expression = sd(normalized_expression),
    se_expression = sd_expression / sqrt(n())  # Standard Error (SE)
  )


# Convert mean and SE to formatted text labels
summary_df$label <- paste0(round(summary_df$mean_expression, 2), " ± ", round(summary_df$se_expression, 2))

# For order and specific colors
factor(dds$sed.bout30m.num, levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))

# Plot with error bars
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = condition, y = mean_expression, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - se_expression, ymax = mean_expression + se_expression),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, y = mean_expression + se_expression + 0.05 * max(mean_expression)), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9), size = 5, vjust = 0) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low" = "red", "Mid" = "blue", "High" = "green")) +
  labs(title = "Relative Levels of miR-664a-3p with Standard Error Bars", 
       x = "Condition", y = "Normalized Expression (Mean ± SE)") +
  theme_minimal() 
```

```{r}
# A volcano plot with better labels
res_df <- as.data.frame(resNAomit)

# Ensure row names (gene names) are available
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

# Define color categories:
# - "red" for unadjusted p-value ≤ 0.05
# - "blue" for adjusted p-value (padj) ≤ 0.10
# - "black" for non-significant genes
res_df$color_category <- ifelse(res_df$pvalue <= 0.05, "red",
                         ifelse(res_df$padj <= 0.10, "blue", "black"))

# Create the volcano plot
EnhancedVolcano(res_df,
    lab = res_df$gene,             # Gene labels
    x = 'log2FoldChange',          # X-axis: log2 fold change
    y = 'pvalue',                  # Y-axis: unadjusted p-value
    pCutoff = 0.05,                # Significance threshold for p-value
    FCcutoff = 0.1,                  # Log2FC threshold
    pointSize = 2.0,               # Point size
    labSize = 3.5,                 # Label size
    colAlpha = 0.6,                # Transparency of points
    title = "miRNA Differential Gene Expression",
    subtitle = "Postpartum active behavior",
    caption = "Red: p ≤ 0.05 | Blue: padj ≤ 0.10",
    colCustom = setNames(res_df$color_category, res_df$gene), # Custom colors
    drawConnectors = TRUE,         # Draw lines connecting labels
    widthConnectors = 0.5,         # Line width
    colConnectors = "black",       # Connector line color
    max.overlaps = 20              # Reduce label clutter
)
```

# Volcano Plot using restults (contrast)
```{r}
res_df <- as.data.frame(resNAomit)

# Ensure log2FoldChange and padj columns are properly formatted
res_df$log2FoldChange <- as.numeric(res_df$log2FoldChange)
res_df$pvalue <- as.numeric(res_df$pvalue)

EnhancedVolcano(res_df,
                lab = rownames(res_df),   # Gene names (or set NULL if not needed)
                x = "log2FoldChange",     # X-axis: Log2 fold change
                y = "pvalue",               # Y-axis: Adjusted p-value
                title = "Active Behavior",
                subtitle = "Number of minutes in moderate-to-vigorous intensity (≥ 3 METs) activity on average",
                selectLab = c("hsa-miR-516b-5p", "hsa-miR-187-3p", "hsa-miR-196a-5p", "hsa-miR-200c-3p", "hsa-miR-2110"
                              ),
                pCutoff = 0.05,           # P-value significance threshold
                FCcutoff = 0.1,             # Fold-change threshold (log2)
                pointSize = 2.0,          # Adjust point size
                labSize = 3.0,            # Label size
                colAlpha = 0.7,           # Transparency
                legendLabels = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
                legendPosition = "right",
                ylim = c(0,4), xlim = c(-3,3),
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                col = c("gray", "blue", "green", "purple"))  # Colors: NS, Down, Up, Both
```

Bubble Plots
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Example dataset (Replace with your actual data)
data <- data.frame(
  Pathway = c("FoxO signaling pathway", "Signaling Pathways regulating pluripotency of stem  cells","Longevity regulating pathway"),
  TargetGene_Count = c(139, 156, 79),
  miRNA_Count = c(1,1,1),  # Number of miRNAs targeting the pathway
  p_value = c(	0.00394, 0.0310, 0.0310)  # Significance values
)

# Convert p-value to -log10 scale for better visualization
data$logP <- -log10(data$p_value)

# Order pathways by enrichment score
data$Pathway <- factor(data$Pathway, levels = data$Pathway[order(data$logP)])

# Create the bubble plot
ggplot(data, aes(x = Pathway, y = logP, size = TargetGene_Count, color = logP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +  # Create bubbles with transparency
  scale_size(range = c(3, 10), name = "Target mRNA Count") +  # Adjust bubble sizes
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "-log10(p-value)") +  # Color based on significance
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +  # Rotate x-axis labels for readability
  labs(title = "Pathways Targeted by hsa-miR-223-3p",
       x = "Pathway",
       y = "-log10 FDR adjusted p-value") 
```

PCA Plot
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)

# Perform PCA on the variance-stabilized or rlog-transformed counts
rlog <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)  # Alternative: rld <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)

# Extract PCA data
pcaData <- plotPCA(rlog, intgroup="Sed_PP", returnData=TRUE)

percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"), 1)

# Define custom colors for conditions
custom_colors <- c("Less than or equal to 15.8" = "lightgreen", "Greater than or equal to 33.4" = "lightblue")

# Plot PCA with specific colors
ggplot(pcaData, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = T3_mvpa)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +  # Apply custom colors
  labs(
    title = "PCA Plot for trimester three active behavior",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", percentVar[1], "%)"),  # Add PC1 variance
    y = paste0("PC2 (", percentVar[2], "%)")   # Add PC2 variance
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

New bar graph, total counts
```{r}
# Assuming 'dds' is your DESeqDataSet object
# Extract normalized counts
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)

# Specify the miRNA of interest
miRNA <- "hsa-miR-148a-3p"

# Check if the miRNA is present in the dataset
if (miRNA %in% rownames(norm_counts)) {
  # Extract normalized counts for the specified miRNA
  miRNA_counts <- norm_counts[miRNA, ]
  
  # Convert to a data frame for easier manipulation
  df <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(norm_counts),
    count = as.numeric(miRNA_counts),
    group = colData(dds)$sed_T2  # Replace with your actual grouping variable
  )
  
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation for each group
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_count = mean(count),
      sd_count = sd(count),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Plot using ggplot2
  plot <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x=group, y=mean_count, fill=group)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(), width=0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_count - sd_count, ymax=mean_count + sd_count),
                  width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.7)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Less than or equal to 0.71" = "lightgreen", "Greater than or equal to 1.57" = "lightblue")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Trimester Two Normalized Counts for", miRNA),
      x = "Group",
      y = "Normalized Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Display the plot
  print(plot)
} else {
  message(paste("miRNA", miRNA, "not found in the dataset."))
}
```

Plot log2fold change
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Ensure DESeq has been run on the dds object
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract DESeq2 results
res <- results(dds)

# Define miRNA of interest
miRNA <- "hsa-miR-148a-3p"

# Check if miRNA exists in results
if (miRNA %in% rownames(res1)) {
  
  # Extract log2 fold change and standard error
  miRNA_df <- as.data.frame(res1[miRNA, ])
  
  # Ensure your dds object contains a condition variable
  condition_levels <- levels(dds$Sed_PP)  # Get condition names
  
  # Create a dataframe for plotting
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    condition = condition_levels,
    log2FoldChange = miRNA_df$log2FoldChange,  # Log2FC per condition
    SE = miRNA_df$lfcSE  # Standard error of log2FC
  )

  # Plot log2 fold change for each condition
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = log2FoldChange, fill = condition)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2FoldChange - SE, ymax = log2FoldChange + SE),
                  width = 0.2, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Less than or equal to 0.86" = "lightblue", "Greater than or equal to 1.71" = "lightgreen")) +  # Custom colors
    labs(
      title = paste("Trimerster One Log2 Fold Change of", miRNA, "Across Conditions"),
      x = "Condition",
      y = "Log2 Fold Change"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
} else {
  message(paste("miRNA", miRNA, "not found in DESeq2 results."))
}
```

Heatmap
```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Load your DESeq2 results (assuming 'dds' is your DESeqDataSet)
rld <- rlog(dds, blind=FALSE)  # rlog transformation

# Extract normalized counts
data_matrix <- assay(rld)

# Get DESeq2 results and filter for significant genes before FDR correction
res <- results(dds)
res <- na.omit(res)

sig_genes <- rownames(res[res$pvalue < 0.05, ])  # Select genes with p-value < 0.05 before FDR correction
data_subset <- data_matrix[sig_genes, ]

# Define annotation for samples
sample_info <- data.frame(condition = colData(dds)$Sed_PP)
rownames(sample_info) <- colnames(data_subset)

# Generate heatmap
pheatmap(data_subset,
         annotation_col = sample_info,
         scale = "row",  # Standardize rows
         color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdBu")))(50),
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Heatmap of Significantly Changed Genes (p < 0.05)")
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
